themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across North America and Europe are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and legal measures centered on border management. Proposals range from mass visa revocations and prohibitive fees in the U.S. to aggressive attacks on government migration management in Spain, Italy, and the U.K.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration moves to pause visa processing and revoke up to 200,000 visas for asylum seekers while proposing a $103,000 H-1B fee.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal and Vox accuse the Spanish government of treason over the Ceuta border surge, labeling it a hybrid war act and warning Ceuta could become 'another Lampedusa'.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini asserts Italy will not become 'Europe's migrant camp,' while Fratelli d'Italia proposes a 'charter of duties' for asylum seekers in Udine.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK highlight Channel crossings, arguing illegal arrivals pose security risks and advocating strict housing prioritization.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in multiple European nations continue to show momentum in opinion polling ahead of regional and national elections. From Germany's AfD holding strong state-level leads to Norway's Progress Party and France's Rassemblement National dominating national surveys, right-wing forces are expanding their electoral reach.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt at 42-43% and maintains a 28% national polling average.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP surges past 30% support in Norwegian polling, doubling its nearest conservative rival Høyre.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen maintains a commanding lead in 2027 French presidential polls, placing first in first-round projections.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD anchors the right-wing Tidö block, maintaining high support while putting pressure on smaller coalition partners.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK wins a Cumberland Council seat in Cumbria, expanding its local electoral footprint.

themes.title: Internal divisions challenge right-wing party unity
themes.blurb: Governing right-wing coalitions and major conservative parties are grappling with internal friction, factional battles, and leadership disputes. Disputes between key figures in Italy, Sweden, Poland, Argentina, and Hungary highlight ongoing governance challenges within right-wing blocs.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini faces internal dissent from northern League leaders like Attilio Fontana, alongside friction with FdI over election timing.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson threatens to drop support for Liberalerna if it fails to clear parliamentary thresholds, straining coalition unity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Factional disputes between Mateusz Morawiecki's Rozwój Plus group and PiS leadership lead to Sejm seating controversies and member resignations.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Power struggles in Casa Rosada escalate as Karina Milei sidelines Santiago Caputo's digital comms team while regional party branches split.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal realignment as key figures step down, while Tisza navigates disputed internal nomination processes.

themes.title: Right-wing parties escalate attacks on public media and press
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and administrations are stepping up confrontations with public broadcasters and independent media outlets. From AfD plans to defund state broadcasters in Germany to sharp verbal attacks on news organizations in Argentina and Hungary, press institutions are emerging as primary targets.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD plans to terminate state broadcasting contracts for MDR and NDR, leading public broadcasters to run warning blackout campaigns.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei escalates aggressive verbal attacks against journalists and media outlets, accusing them of trying to destabilize his administration.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Péter Magyar publicly attacks independent outlets 444 and Telex over critical coverage, amid ongoing debates over public media oversight.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing administrations and parties are advancing spending cuts, budget recalibrations, and deregulatory measures to handle fiscal constraints. Debates center on refusing state debt relief, altering tax structures, and curbing public expenditure.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government explicitly rejects financial assistance for over 5 million indebted families, citing personal responsibility while enforcing fiscal austerity.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini calls for a €20 billion budget expansion as the government debates temporary fuel tax cuts and bank windfall taxes.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK proposes deregulatory measures for small businesses, scrapping GDPR, and reversing inheritance taxes on family farms.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The government introduces hundreds of billions of HUF in budget savings to control state deficit targets.
